title: Sirrocans
subtitle: A 5E-compatible character race of giant-blooded desert nomads
shortDescription: A 10-page 5E-compatible character race supplement for giant-blooded desert nomads of the deep desert.
longDescription: Sirrocans presents a giant-blooded desert people shaped by black-stone wastes, buried ruins, sacred tribal songs, and survival under an unforgiving sky. The supplement combines player-facing racial traits with cultural grounding, naming traditions, roleplaying guidance, and Sirrocan equipment so the ancestry feels playable at the table instead of sketched in from a distance.
features: 5E-compatible character race for giant-blooded desert nomads
Six Giant Ancestry options tied to Cloud, Fire, Frost, Hill, Stone, and Storm lineages
Desert-Born, Powerful Build, Natural Athlete, and Wastewise Craft racial traits
Sirrocan names, tribes, ideals, bonds, flaws, and roleplaying guidance
Sirrocan Buckler and Sirrocan Shortspear cultural equipment
creationMethod: Human-authored by RV Sawyer. All artwork in this product is Copyright 2026 RV Sawyer.
legalNote: Independent work compatible with fifth edition fantasy roleplaying games. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or approved by Wizards of the Coast LLC. Includes SRD 5.1 and SRD 5.2.1 material under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.
